Subject: HelmBridge renewal: sequencing the tier-shift addendum & indemnity carve-out

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call yesterday. Attached is the draft addendum that sequences the tier-stacking change and documents the capacity uplift we discussed (HB-Addendum-TierStack-v1.docx). High level:
- Term: convert to an 18-month committed term starting 2026-11-01 (we propose a prorated bridge for Oct).
- Capacity: add 120k inference-hours/year (split 70/30 between production and dev sandboxes).
- Pricing: blended unit price with the uplift; named in exhibit A.
- Legal ask: we included Redwood's standard indemnity carve limited to third-party IP claims and a data-processing mutual limitation.

Can you have your legal team send redlines back by EOD Thu (9/10)? We also need to confirm signature path (PO + e-sign) — David is on this thread and can coordinate procurement.

Attachments: HB-Addendum-TierStack-v1.docx (proposed addendum; highlights on sections 2, 4, 6)

Best,

From: Anna Castillo <anna@helmbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@helmbridge.com, Sam Walker <sam.walker@helmbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: HelmBridge renewal: sequencing the tier-shift addendum & indemnity carve-out

Thanks Naomi — we reviewed internally and have inline redlines plus higher-level comments. See attached (HelmBridge_Redlines_v1.docx). Key items:

1) Indemnity carve: HelmBridge cannot accept broad indemnities that cover downstream SaaS customers. We propose an IP-only indemnity (no product use indemnity) and a cap tied to fees for the uplift period.

2) Data residency and audit logs: product team requests that audit-logging retention be extended to 13 months for compliance with our internal policy. They also want confirmation that logs for production inference are stored in us-west-2.

3) Term sequencing: we understand the 18-month ask but want the ability to transition existing seats out if usage materially declines after month 9. Proposed language: a mid-term usage review leading to adjustment rights.

4) Billing & PO path: procurement needs a consolidated year-1 invoice and a single PO for uplift + base subscription. They asked for a sample invoice format.

Sam added a note: the 120k inference-hours looks good but we need a short SOW appendix that maps the ramp by quarter.

We can get redlines back in the document by EOD tomorrow (9/11) but wanted to surface the above items early.

Thanks,
Anna Castillo
General Counsel — HelmBridge

Attachment: HelmBridge_Redlines_v1.docx (inline annotations on clauses 2.1, 4.3, 6.2)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Anna Castillo <anna@helmbridge.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: HelmBridge renewal: sequencing the tier-shift addendum & indemnity carve-out

Anna / Naomi / David —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Anna. I reviewed HelmBridge_Redlines_v1 and have attached Redwood's proposed language (RB_Reply_Redlines.docx). Summary of our positions and proposed compromises:

1) Indemnity: we can accept narrowing the indemnity to direct IP claims and will add a carve limiting downstream customer claims, but we cannot accept a fee-tied cap that is lower than 12 months of fees for the uplift portion (to preserve risk allocation across the committed term). Proposed text in section 6.2.

2) Data residency & logs: we confirm production inference logs will be retained in us-west-2 by default. We are willing to extend audit-log retention to 13 months for production logs (exceptions: sandbox/dev logs will remain 90 days by default). Added language in section 4.3 with a NetOps SLA for retention.

3) Mid-term usage review: reasonable ask. Proposed: a usage review at month 9 to surface significant deviations; either party may initiate a good-faith replanning exercise; any seat reductions will follow a 60-day notice and will not retroactively change fees already invoiced. See section 2.4.

4) Billing/PO: we can supply a consolidated invoice template (attachment: Sample-Invoice-HelmBridge.pdf, inline in RB_Reply_Redlines). David — I can pass the template to you; Naomi please confirm whether HelmBridge requires separate invoices per legal entity.

5) SOW ramp appendix: we propose adding Appendix B that maps quarter-by-quarter ramp and acceptance milestones; Naomi/David, please confirm the Q1/Q2 percentages that Sam needs.

If these are acceptable, I can produce a clean addendum for e-signature and draft the DocuSign envelope. We would like final confirmation by COB Monday (9/14) to keep the 11/1 effective date intact.

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Commercial Contracts — Redwood Inference
